bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the commissioner of health for grants for substance misuse prevention, education, and recovery programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; GRANTS FOR SUBSTANCE MISUSE PREVENTION, EDUCATION, AND RECOVERY PROGRAMS. +]

[+$3,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $3,600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for grants to local health departments and Tribal health departments for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 144.197, subdivision 4. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the commissioner of health for grants for substance misuse prevention, education, and recovery programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; GRANTS FOR SUBSTANCE MISUSE PREVENTION, EDUCATION, AND RECOVERY PROGRAMS.

$3,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $3,600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for grants to local health departments and Tribal health departments for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 144.197, subdivision 4.
additions: APPROPRIATIONS; GRANTS FOR SUBSTANCE MISUSE PREVENTION, EDUCATION, AND RECOVERY PROGRAMS.

$3,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $3,600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for grants to local health departments and Tribal health departments for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 144.197, subdivision 4.
